Meta’s FY2022–FY2024 revenue grew from $116,609 million to $164,501 million, as disclosed in its FY2024 Form 10‑K. [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]  

These are both GAAP revenues for fiscal years ended December 31, so the periods and accounting bases are directly comparable.

Cumulative revenue growth 2022–2024 (using (2024/2022 − 1)):

- Alphabet: (350,018 / 282,836 − 1) ≈ 23.75% [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]  
- Meta: (164,501 / 116,609 − 1) ≈ 41.07% [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]  

Difference in cumulative growth:  
41.07% − 23.75% ≈ 17.3 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta had faster cumulative revenue growth, by roughly 17 percentage points.
